in_sanskrit.name: भवर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root 'bhau' meaning 'to be', 'to exist', 'to create', and the suffix 'ar' meaning 'one who', 'ruler of'. One who brings happiness into existence or creates happiness.

in_hindi.name: भवर
in_hindi.long_meaning: In Hindi, 'bhawar' can be translated as 'bhagya vadiya', meaning 'one who brings good fortune' or 'one who is blessed'.

in_tamil.name: பவர்
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, 'pavar' can mean 'lord' or 'master'. So, 'bhawar' could be interpreted as 'lord of happiness' or 'master of happiness'.

in_telugu.name: భవర్
in_telugu.long_meaning: In Telugu, 'bhawar' can be translated as 'bhogodheshapurojit', meaning 'one who rules over happiness' or 'one who is the lord of happiness'.

in_marathi.name: Bhawar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Time
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhawar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who holds the universe in the palm of his hand, the Lord of Time and Creator of the Universe

in_bengali.name: Bhawar
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of Time
in_bengali.long_meaning: Bhawar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who holds the universe in the palm of his hand, the Lord of Time and Creator of the Universe
